items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: I remember one of the guys in it was Jacquet. That was his last name because I knew him.

ctx.x: You got a note here, Dick, for rowing clubs? Yeah, did you ever work for any rowing clubs? Were you in the band when they did that, the Owls?

Yes, we played a couple of jobs for the rowing club there. We used to row that two-mile job along the New Basin Canal. You remember? I remember one of the guys in it was Jacquet. That was his last name because I knew him. Camille. Camille Jacquet. He was the stroke woman over there. And we wanted, the Yacht Club, we played a couple of jobs at the Yacht Club and they wanted to give us a membership and everything else if we'd play two or three given nights, Saturday nights in the year.
Is that the Southern Yacht Club?
